acceptance_evidence: CCA verdict and MergeGate evidence are recorded before completion.
completion_conditions: Contract mode accepts a source plan that this PR ADDS, unmodified, and still rejects a modified plan or a plan that is not the goal's source_plan.
The MergeGate metadata job supplies the Guardian evidence its own gate reads, so a high-risk Contract PR is not blocked there for missing input files.
The audit-remediation plan is on the default branch when this PR merges, which is the bootstrap this task exists to perform.
validate_shiki and the full suite stay green.

decisions: Contract mode is deadlocked as delivered: it blocks with 'source_plan not found' when the plan is absent from the judged tree, and with 'contract must not change .shiki/plans/...' when the PR carries it. Nothing else puts a plan on the default branch, so no Goal whose plan is not already there can ever be registered.

The operator-approved resolution is the audit's recommendation: authoring or modifying a spec_freeze block stays forbidden; a Contract PR may register an unmodified source plan add-only, with the maintainer-applied mergegate:contract label as the human countersignature.

The metadata job's Guardian blockers are a second, independent defect: contract mode forces Guardian evaluation from the Goal's risk level, but that job passes no --guardian-* flags, so the evaluator blocks on missing input rather than on a missing approval. Scoped here because it blocks the same PR; the base-snapshot half stays with R-06.

This task is deliberately a single-task goal so it can land through the ordinary task-PR path, and it carries the audit-remediation plan itself. That is the same bootstrap shape as the Contract PR path in PR #179: the task that removes a circularity is the one task that must not depend on it.
grill_with_docs.source: Live block on Contract PR #182, 2026-07-29. Predicted verbatim by the ADR 0015 audit and left as operator decision 2 until it came due.

non_goals: Permitting a PR to author or modify a spec_freeze block — creation and modification stay forbidden; only add-only registration of an unmodified plan is allowed.
Changing goal_reconcile mode, which is a recovery path and correctly forbids the goal file and the plan.
Changing the required-check set or which job evaluates the Guardian gate.
Building the base .shiki snapshot or --merged-prs plumbing for the metadata job — that is remediation task R-06.
outcome: A Contract PR can register a Goal whose spec-frozen plan is not yet on the default branch, and the MergeGate metadata check stops blocking a high-risk Contract PR for Guardian evidence it was never given. Contract PR #182, carrying the audit-remediation Goal's 16 task contracts, becomes mergeable — which is what unblocks every remaining planned task.
title: Unblock Contract PRs: register the source plan, and give the metadata check its Guardian evidence
